motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Movement is removed on the documented paths. Secondary-button active translation and chip event delay remain source caveats, not reusable rules.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Shared physical action with a short press response.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height:52px; padding:13px 22px; display:inline-flex; gap:12px; justify-content:center; align-items:center; border-radius:6px; font-size:15px; font-weight:800; white-space:nowrap; box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--button-depth, #0d241f); transition:transform 120ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),background 120ms,box-shadow 120ms; }.ds-button-primary { background:var(--accent, var(--stitch-primary, #f0cc75)); color:var(--accent-foreground, var(--stitch-on-primary, #2a261b)); }.ds-button-primary { font-family:var(--font-body, Manrope),"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; border:0; }.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--accent-soft, var(--stitch-primary-container, #ffdc8e)); transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 7px 0 var(--button-depth, #0d241f); }.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(4px); box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--button-depth, #0d241f); }.ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, var(--stitch-primary, #f0cc75)); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; box-shadow:none; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition-duration:0ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled),.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:none; } }

narrative.overview:
PokerChip Ledger uses a Balatro-inspired game interface: deep green felt, charcoal control surfaces, warm paper cards and chunky colored controls. Clear actions and readable poker state set the hierarchy. This user-authorized world replaces the rejected tournament broadcast and celadon system.

Bungee gives Latin headings and numerical readouts their game character; Manrope and Chinese system fallbacks keep functional copy legible. Card fans, printed card backs and short physical press responses supply the personality. Copy stays concise: action verbs, functional nouns and rules needed to make a decision.

This is a source-derived record, not a claim of browser validation. Normative token values above come from [theme](src/styles/stitch-theme.css), [globals](src/app/globals.css), [spacing tokens](src/styles/tokens.css), [font setup](src/app/layout.tsx) and sampled components. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) retains product truth; [the surface brief](docs/surfaces/entry-redesign.md) owns page strategy. Local scoring needs no account; synced rooms require an account and a four-digit code. Hosts choose scoring-only or server-dealt play.
keyCharacteristics: Deep felt, warm card stock and charcoal control surfaces.
Red create-room, blue join-room and gold local-scoring controls.
Compact task forms and direct game-menu copy.
Event-driven card and chip motion with reduced-motion paths.

rules.name: The Labeled Color Rule
rules.body: Pair every action or status color with a readable label, sign or game symbol.

rules.name: The Readable Ledger Rule
rules.body: Keep names, balances and actions distinct; reserve dense type for the table's compact metadata.

rules.name: The Physical Feedback Rule
rules.body: Use the dark lower edge to show a control's rest, hover and pressed state; keep the motion brief and tied to interaction.

dos: **Do** use the deep felt, charcoal, paper and colored-action tokens through the shared theme.
**Do** keep concise action labels, explicit field labels and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** preserve local scoring without an account and distinguish scoring-only rooms from server-dealt play.
**Do** allow dense tables to grow vertically while keeping cards and game state readable.
**Do** keep phone actions in normal document flow and desktop actions in the right sidebar.
**Do** tie card, pot and chip movement to entry or actual state changes and respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** restore the rejected broadcast/celadon identity, promotional hero or split auth story.
**Don't** add invitation slogans, invented claims or decorative feature cards.
**Don't** copy Balatro artwork, branding or rules; the reference governs visual and motion character.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate a turn, outcome or action.
**Don't** hide dealt cards to preserve an arbitrary table height.
**Don't** add looping ornamental motion or delay a game-state update for an animation.
